ep41 · white pot alone we win: 0.515 vs 0.287

Clean evidence, correct scans, segments match the truth; the carry brings MPPE 9.7 → 4.3 cm and beats Edmond 0.515 vs 0.287. Held back by the pooled pot mesh (explains 0.31: two-handle pool) and a slip guard that turned 6 grasps into 1 + 9 bridges.

ep13 · blue cup placed in the dish rack we lose: 0.120 vs 0.475

ep0 · white pot with its lid we win: 0.424 vs 0.237

Both pipelines fail the lid. Ours assigns pot-on-lid and lid-on-pot at once, settle drives the pot 51 mm into its support, the lid jumps 12 cm, and the lid mesh is a 41 cm disc (scan 19 cm). Still (0.424) beats every track from either side.

ep23 · two wooden boards we win: 0.205 vs 0.128

Our best meshes (scans 0.03 cm, registration 1.00) and still 0.205: board 1's grasp failed, board 2 had no solvable grasp, both tracks end 10 cm off. Rotation is the loss (oracle +0.60); the boards come out 1 cm thick vs 3 (half-seen).
